liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Very tight, with a long intro jam of about 1:31 before Garcia's first verse; Remembered from an 80s tape as a great Scarlet into Fire, with tight playing from Brent [17][22]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Audience sang happy birthday to Garcia before this opener; he looked dazed and barely responded [12]
- **Me And My Uncle** (1 review): Up-tempo version praised as one of the best the reviewer has heard [20]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): Intro is slinky and somewhat unsure, as the tune was still being refined and was new [17]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Reviewer's favorite version from an 80s soundboard copy; the audience tape suffers from wind noise [21]
- **Space** (1 review): Space into The Other One is called lucid, with intricate ensemble jamming; Wharf Rat emerges about eighteen minutes later [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-07-31.sbd.miller.88149.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 4.09/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is crystalline; small guitar tweaks are audible in songs like Little Red Rooster; Audience recording is hurt by wind, so the soundboard serves the music better; Sound shifts after each tape flip; bass boosted on a patch source; source discs heavily EQ'd [1][19][21]
- **gd1983-07-31.sbd.miller.bandrofcheck.loossy-version-of-88149.98125.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min [2]
- **gd1983-07-31.167469.akg.330bt.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 166 min [3]
- **gd1983-07-31.162294.nak300-cp4.shields-hughes.flac2496**: source not stated; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Set II, taped in front of the soundboard, has deep rich bass and a near-perfect mix of Jerry's guitar [7]
- **gd83-07-31.aud.dodd.11933.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 12 [10]. Said about its sound: Audience tape starts warbly but settles in by West L.A. Fadeaway; Audience recording isn't great but better than many; reviewer heard only the second set and found it pleasant; Audience quality takes about two minutes to get used to, then sounds surprisingly good to a soundboard-focused listener [14][15][17]

## Around the show

- Jerry's birthday: crowd sang to him before the opener, but he seemed out of it and barely acknowledged them [12]
- Described as the last show of the summer 1983 tour [7]
- Reviewer's second show; judged well below the previous day's show, though the Saturday Night encore was fun [13]
- Seen as the overlooked sibling of the previous night's show, but deserving a better reputation [14]
- Double encore noted as uncommon for Dead shows [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-07-31.sbd.miller.88149.flac16**: taped by Disks provided by Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cass -> Dat -> CD [1]. Also: Front-of-board Sony ECM200T recording, cassette master to DAT; soundboard lineage unconfirmed, with patches from other sources; Patches fill part of Fire On The Mountain, the last seconds of Touch Of Grey, and all of One More Saturday Night [1]
- **gd1983-07-31.sbd.miller.bandrofcheck.loossy-version-of-88149.98125.flac16**: transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck; source: Lossy Transfer of shnid 88149 [2]. Also: CDs burned as one track, played through Windows Media Player and Sound Forge, gaps removed, then converted to FLAC [2]
- **gd1983-07-31.167469.akg.330bt.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Ken Kelley; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Ken Kelley's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG 330BT mics > JVC KD-2 w/Super ANRS (Maxell XLII-S90) [3]. Also: Sony ECM 220T source from Rango Keshavan supplies the first 24 seconds of Jack Straw and two Space patches [3]
- **gd1983-07-31.162294.nak300-cp4.shields-hughes.flac2496**: taped by Les Shields and Kevin T. Hughes; transferred by Kevin T. Hughes; source: Nak CM300 Microphones w/ CP4 Shotgun Caps > Sony D5 Recorder (Set I-1st; Set II 3rd patch in Master Recording Chain) > Maxell MX 90 Cassette(s) [7]. Also: Same gear for both sets; Set I taped late from a poor spot, left of center in front of Phil, causing minor bass saturation [7]
- **gd83-07-31.aud.dodd.11933.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>DAT>CDR [10]
